expectations.text: Compares three weeks for one Go developer against the roughly ten-week first-release plan and says which interview answer (effort ceiling, deadline) moved the recommendation.
expectations.evidence: The 'Why the schedule is also wrong' section says the template 'runs about 10 weeks to a 1.0.0 or 0.x tag' and 'assumes a passing gate and one developer for the whole time,' so the comparison is there, but only by implication. It never sets 3 weeks against 10 to name the shortfall. It also never says that the deadline or the one-developer limit changed the recommendation. The no-go rests on the demand and API-gate blockers, and the 'Assumptions to confirm' section lists only unanswered questions (Q3-Q6), not the answers that drove the verdict.
